mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, and you can catch the ISS flying over from the Mount Horeb direction toward Madison near the Home Depot around 6:32 PM, appearing about halfway up the sky.

The Verona Municipal Court reminds residents that you can pay most traffic citations online or by phone without appearing in court, unless a mandatory appearance is noted. Additionally, the City Plan Commission will meet on December 7th to review development projects, including the Sub-Zero site plan at Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do around Verona, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today and live music at Bailey's Run or Paddy Mac's today. Tomorrow, catch the music of John Denver at the High School Fine Arts Center.
On October 23rd, police cited parents after two 13-year-olds were caught riding prohibited e-motorcycles on Ashton Drive.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM with the delicious Caramel Cashew as the flavor of the day.
